general.title: General Settings
general.subtitle: Configure basic server settings for WolfStar.
general.server_info_description: Your server at a glance. Adjust settings below or explore sections in the sidebar.
general.server_id_copied_description: The server ID has been copied to your clipboard.
general.prefix_description: The prefix used to trigger WolfStar commands in this server.
general.language_description: The language WolfStar uses for responses in this server.
general.no_activity_description: Changes you make to this server's settings will appear here so you can track who changed what.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: Configure the roles WolfStar uses for moderation, permissions, and automation.
roles.configurable_help: Assign roles for core bot functions like moderation and auto-assignment.
roles.restricted_help: Roles applied when a restriction command is used.

channels.title: Channel Settings
channels.subtitle: Choose where WolfStar posts logs and which channels to ignore.
channels.logging_channels_help: Select which channels should receive specific log events. Leave empty to disable logging for that event.
channels.excluded_channels_help: Select channels that should be ignored for specific logging events. Messages and events in these channels won't be logged.

events.title: Event Settings
events.subtitle: Configure which events should be logged and tracked
events.moderation_events_help: These events involve moderation actions. Please set up a Moderation Logs channel on {channelsPage}.
events.message_events_help: These events track message activity. The required channels vary by event type and can be configured on {channelsPage}.

moderation.title: Punishment Settings
moderation.subtitle: Configure how WolfStar handles moderation actions like bans, kicks, and mutes.

commands.title: Commands
commands.subtitle: Choose which commands to enable or disable on your server

common.hard_action_description: What happens when a member exceeds the limit
common.duration_help: How long the mute or ban lasts
common.alerts_help: Posts an alert in the channel where the violation occurred.
common.logging_help: Sends a log message to the configured moderation log channel.
common.delete_message_help: Deletes the message that triggered the filter.

word.title: Word Filter
word.toggle_help: Blocks messages containing specific words or phrases.

capitals.title: Capital Letters Filter
capitals.toggle_help: Blocks messages with too many uppercase characters.

invites.title: Invite Link Filter
invites.toggle_help: Blocks Discord invite links posted in chat.

messages.title: Message Duplication Filter
messages.save_failed: Couldn't save message duplication filter settings. {message}

lines.title: Line Spam Filter
lines.toggle_help: Blocks messages with too many new lines.
lines.maximum_help: Maximum amount of new lines in a message before filter is applied
lines.save_failed: Couldn't save new line filter settings. {message}

rolesRemoveInitial.name: Remove Initial
rolesRemoveInitial.tooltip: When enabled, claiming a public role automatically removes the initial role.

rolesAdmin.name: Administrator
rolesAdmin.tooltip: The administrator roles. Administrators have access to all moderation and management commands. Defaults to anyone with the "Manage Server" permission.

rolesInitial.name: Initial
rolesInitial.tooltip: The initial role, if configured, is assigned to users as soon as they join.

rolesModerator.name: Moderator
rolesModerator.tooltip: The moderator roles. Moderators have access to almost all moderation commands. Defaults to anyone who can ban members

rolesMuted.name: Muted
rolesMuted.tooltip: The muted role, if configured, is assigned to muted users. If no muted role is set, you are prompted to create one.

rolesRestrictedReaction.name: Restricted Reaction
rolesRestrictedReaction.tooltip: Assigned to members whose reactions are restricted.

rolesRestrictedEmbed.name: Restricted Embed
rolesRestrictedEmbed.tooltip: Assigned to members who are restricted from embedding links.

rolesRestrictedAttachment.name: Restricted Attachment
rolesRestrictedAttachment.tooltip: Assigned to members who are restricted from uploading attachments.

rolesRestrictedEmoji.name: Restricted Emoji
rolesRestrictedEmoji.tooltip: Assigned to members who are restricted from using external emojis.

rolesRestrictedVoice.name: Restricted Voice
rolesRestrictedVoice.tooltip: Assigned to members who are restricted from joining voice channels.

rolesPublic.name: Public Roles
rolesPublic.tooltip: The public roles. These can be claimed by any user using the "roles" command.

messagesModerationAutoDelete.name: Hide Message
messagesModerationAutoDelete.description: Deletes the command message to keep the moderator anonymous.

messagesModerationDm.name: Message User
messagesModerationDm.description: Sends the punished member a DM with the reason and duration.

messagesModerationMessageDisplay.name: Send Punishment Response
messagesModerationMessageDisplay.description: Posts a confirmation message after a punishment is applied.

messagesModerationReasonDisplay.name: Show Reason
messagesModerationReasonDisplay.description: Includes the reason in the punishment response message.

messagesModeratorNameDisplay.name: Show Mod Name
messagesModeratorNameDisplay.description: Includes the moderator's name in the DM sent to the punished member.

eventsBanAdd.title: Ban Added
eventsBanAdd.description: An anonymous moderation log is posted when a member is banned.

eventsBanRemove.title: Ban Revoked
eventsBanRemove.description: An anonymous moderation log is posted when a member is unbanned.

eventsTwemojiReactions.title: Twemoji Reactions
eventsTwemojiReactions.description: When a member reacts with a Twemoji, the reaction is sent to the Reaction Logs channel.

channelsLogsMemberAdd.name: Member Add Logs
channelsLogsMemberAdd.description: Receives a log message when a member joins the server.

channelsLogsMemberRemove.name: Member Remove Logs
channelsLogsMemberRemove.description: Receives a log message when a member leaves, is kicked, or is banned.

channelsLogsMemberNicknameUpdate.name: Member Nickname Update Logs
channelsLogsMemberNicknameUpdate.description: Receives a log message when a member changes their nickname.

channelsLogsMemberUsernameUpdate.name: Member Username Update Logs
channelsLogsMemberUsernameUpdate.description: Receives a log message when a member changes their username.

channelsLogsMemberRolesUpdate.name: Member Role Logs
channelsLogsMemberRolesUpdate.description: Receives a log message when a member gains or loses a role.

channelsLogsMessageDelete.name: Message Delete Logs
channelsLogsMessageDelete.description: Receives a log message when a message is deleted.

channelsLogsMessageDeleteNsfw.name: NSFW Message Delete Logs
channelsLogsMessageDeleteNsfw.description: Receives a log message when a message from an NSFW channel is deleted.

channelsLogsMessageUpdate.name: Message Update Logs
channelsLogsMessageUpdate.description: Receives a log message when a message is edited.

channelsLogsMessageUpdateNsfw.name: NSFW Message Update Logs
channelsLogsMessageUpdateNsfw.description: Receives a log message when a message from an NSFW channel is edited.

channelsLogsModeration.name: Moderation Logs
channelsLogsModeration.description: Receives all moderation case logs. Required for moderation events to work.

channelsLogsImage.name: Image Logs
channelsLogsImage.description: Receives re-uploaded copies of images posted in the server.

channelsLogsPrune.name: Prune Logs
channelsLogsPrune.description: Receives a log message when messages are bulk-deleted (pruned).

channelsLogsReaction.name: Reaction Logs
channelsLogsReaction.description: Receives a log message when a reaction is added to a message.

channelsLogsChannelCreate.name: Channel Create Logs
channelsLogsChannelCreate.description: Receives a log message when a new channel is created.

channelsLogsChannelUpdate.name: Channel Update Logs
channelsLogsChannelUpdate.description: Receives a log message when any channel is updated, including the changes made.

channelsLogsChannelDelete.name: Channel Delete Logs
channelsLogsChannelDelete.description: Receives a log message when a channel is deleted.

channelsLogsEmojiCreate.name: Emoji Create Logs
channelsLogsEmojiCreate.description: Receives a log message when a new emoji is created.

channelsLogsEmojiUpdate.name: Emoji Update Logs
channelsLogsEmojiUpdate.description: Receives a log message when an emoji is updated, including the changes made.

channelsLogsEmojiDelete.name: Emoji Delete Logs
channelsLogsEmojiDelete.description: Receives a log message when an emoji is deleted.

channelsLogsRoleCreate.name: Role Create Logs
channelsLogsRoleCreate.description: Receives a log message when a new role is created.

channelsLogsRoleUpdate.name: Role Update Logs
channelsLogsRoleUpdate.description: Receives a log message when a role is updated, including the changes made.

channelsLogsRoleDelete.name: Role Delete Logs
channelsLogsRoleDelete.description: Receives a log message when a role is deleted.

channelsLogsServerUpdate.name: Server Update Logs
channelsLogsServerUpdate.description: Receives a log message when the server settings are updated, including the changes made.

channelsIgnoreAll.name: All logs
channelsIgnoreAll.description: Channels excluded from all types of logging.

messagesIgnoreChannels.name: Message Delete, Edit and Reaction Add logs
messagesIgnoreChannels.description: Channels excluded from message-delete, message-edit, and reaction-add logging.
